decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 14th September 2008 when the use shall cease and the marquees shall be removed within one week of that date.  The site of the marquee shall be made good, levelled and laid to grass no later than 15 October 2008

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Hours of Use, 10am to 11.30 pm on all days except Sundays when events will end at 11pm.
Condition : 4 - No excavations shall take place for the construction of, or for the purposes of the use of the marquee.

Condition : 5 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff cars associated with the use parked in no place other than the main public car park or in the Lime Avenue car parking area (using the latter only in the event that the main public car park is already full) or the designated disabled persons' parking spaces shown on the plans hereby approved and shall ensure that these car parking areas are shown in the submitted application are available exclusively to visitors and staff at the event.
Condition : 6 - Music noise emanating from this premises between 23.00 and 07.00 shall be inaudible at the fa?ade of the nearest residential property.
Condition : 7 - No firework displays shall take place in conjunction with any event held in or adjoining the Marquees hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff do not enter the area of the nearby Site of Special Scientific interest.

Condition : 9 - The roof of the marquee shall be fully covered by the green netting, a sample of which was submitted to the local planning authority in the letter from The Northumberland Estates dated 11 March 2008, which shall be securely and permanently fixed to the structure.
description: Change of use from a garden area to the temporary erection of a marquee for private/corporate events at the site.
